name: Family Wall Calendar
description: A bright, touch-friendly family calendar and chore chart: Day, Week, Month and Schedule views, color-coded family members, tap-to-open event details, and a tap-to-tick chore list.
author: cyberbandit1998

defaultView.title: Starting view
defaultView.description: The view shown at start-up and after the wall has been idle.

showWeekends.title: Show weekends
showWeekends.description: Turn off for a Monday to Friday week view.

maxEventsPerDay.title: Events per day in Month view
maxEventsPerDay.description: Extra events collapse into a '+ more' line.

showPeopleBar.title: Show family filter
showPeopleBar.description: A row of family members (or calendars) you can tap to filter the events.

showChores.title: Show Chores tab
showChores.description: Reads today's chores from Home Screens' chore chart.

choresTappable.title: Tap to tick off chores
choresTappable.description: Turn off to make the chore list read-only.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Auto picks light or dark from the module's background color.

accentColor.title: Accent color
accentColor.description: Used for today, the selected tab and buttons.

returnToTodaySeconds.title: Return to today after (seconds)
returnToTodaySeconds.description: After this much time without a touch, jump back to today and the starting view. 0 keeps whatever was last opened.
